job: Search, filter and act on a list, with controls wrapping instead of scrolling.
purpose: A row for the controls above a list: search, filters and view controls at the start, export and create at the end. It wraps instead of scrolling, and the search takes a full row on phones. It lives in a small-padded band.
useWhen: A table, list or grid needs search, filters and one create action.
View controls and export belong at the end of the row.

avoidWhen.when: The title row of a page.
A filter state that needs chips for what is applied.
Tabs that switch views of the same data.

variants.useWhen: The search takes the full row instead of its 280px maximum.

parts.role: The group pushed to the end.
